resolution: Fixed both sticker reports in commit 0135be303 (pure JS — hot reload delivers, no rebuild). (1) Authored pieces take stamps now: the stamp path had copied Paint Faces semantics which skips model: pieces (no slots) and the host catalog raycast can't see them; the JS AABB pick (pickAuthoredPlacement) now names its ray entry face — rayAabbEntry returns the entry axis+side, converted to a world hit point + outward normal — and stampStickerAt takes whichever pick is nearest, recording role 'surface' for authored stamps. A ray starting inside the box yields no stampable face. (2) The mid-turn z-thrash report: overlapping stickers all floated at the same 8mm so the depth buffer coin-flipped per camera angle; each stamp on a piece now lifts 2mm above the previous — stamp order IS stack order, the last sticker slapped sits on top like reality. stickers.test.ts grew to 12 cases including the authored yaw-90 stamp round trip and the stack-order lift.
